case: PostgreSQL scalar enum XLSX re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: The PostgreSQL result contains the literal NULL label, Unicode, markup, formula-shaped text and SQL NULL; native enum type/value assertions pass.
BookiE writes non-NULL enum labels as XLSX shared strings without formulas, leaves SQL NULL blank, and refuses an empty label without replacing the existing workbook.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook and saves ODS, then reopens and saves XLSX; literal NULL, Unicode, markup and formula-shaped labels remain identical strings, and SQL NULL remains blank.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=/home/trung/Projects/tablepro/linux/docs/evidence/postgres-enum-scalar-calc-reimport-results-2026-10-04/source.xlsx cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_file_export_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_xlsx_file_export_keeps_text_labels_and_refuses_empty_safely -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: In the pinned Debian image, apt installs libreoffice-calc; Calc opens source.xlsx and saves recheck/source.ods.
Calc reopens recheck/source.ods and saves recheck/source.xlsx, retained as calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.result: BookiE XLSX, Calc ODS and Calc XLSX preserve all tested scalar labels; SQL NULL stays blank.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other spreadsheet applications and enum cell shapes remain open in B3; this single scalar enum Calc case does not close the engine/type/consumer/configuration matrix.
